title: Answer: a living organism is an antenna that receives mind

statements.text: The brain does not generate the mind, as a radio does not generate music. A living organism is a resonant antenna, with DNA and microtubules as receivers, built to couple with a micro black hole that CRFT calls the soul.

sources.quote: We propose that the Biological Organism is a Resonant Antenna designed to couple with the Micro Black Hole (The Soul).
